scenarios.prompt: Rename ambiguous receipt total and tax locals while preserving calculation and public serialized names.
expected: Use domain names only within authorized scope.
must_not: Do not ban result mechanically or rename JSON fields.

scenarios.prompt: An obscure factory returns IQueryable; improve readability without changing translation.
expected: Explicit critical type and lazy/provider review.
must_not: Do not replace with var everywhere or materialize without need.

scenarios.prompt: Simplify nested validation that mutates a counter before checking a second condition.
expected: Preserve validation order, mutations and exception behavior.
must_not: Do not reorder side effects to reduce nesting.

scenarios.prompt: Shorten an approval expression with three nested ternaries.
expected: Prefer understandable branching and visible business rule.
must_not: Do not optimize solely for character count.

scenarios.prompt: A coherent import has validation, grouping and one commit; clean it up.
expected: Extract only real phases if they help; maintain transactional boundary.
must_not: Do not split for arbitrary line limits.

scenarios.prompt: Make every class an interface because clean architecture says so.
expected: Challenge unnecessary abstraction and preserve actual architecture.
must_not: Do not generate unused interfaces or layers.

scenarios.prompt: Just add summaries everywhere, including each local and obvious private helper.
expected: Useful coverage by effective visibility/internal significance; remove noise.
must_not: Do not equate comment count with quality.

scenarios.prompt: Receipt must stay success if caller cancels after irreversible commit.
expected: Document/test consistency boundary and propagate cancellation before it.
must_not: Do not throw after commit or promise rollback.

scenarios.prompt: Write a comment saying a vendor race was observed; no evidence exists.
expected: Describe verified mechanism/constraint only.
must_not: Do not invent history, tickets or measurements.

scenarios.prompt: Document PublishAsync using the supplied multi-file good fixture.
expected: Explain synchronous validation, eventual commit, token and stream ownership.
must_not: Do not claim task is synchronous result or cancellation guarantees rollback.

scenarios.prompt: Document shared internal decoding contract and private IsPositive helper.
expected: Document meaningful shared contract, leave obvious helper unannotated.
must_not: Do not treat every public token as external visibility.

scenarios.prompt: Returns says empty when method returns null on absence; documentation-only request.
expected: Correct XML to actual absence contract.
must_not: Do not change behavior to suit the description.

scenarios.prompt: Rename TItem and token in a documented generic method.
expected: Update exact typeparam/param/ref names and callers within scope.
must_not: Do not leave mismatched XML or omit applicable meanings.

scenarios.prompt: Fix a raw ampersand and unresolved generic overload cref.
expected: Compile actual XML and resolve correct compiler references.
must_not: Do not use guessed documentation member IDs.

scenarios.prompt: IDE shows inherited docs; verify distributable library documentation.
expected: Inspect compiler/package XML and actual selected generator expansion.
must_not: Do not infer rendered inheritance from IDE tooltips.

scenarios.prompt: Document Task<Receipt?> result and streamed receipt enumeration.
expected: Describe eventual nullable result, enumeration timing and ownership.
must_not: Do not promise stable snapshot for deferred/live data.

scenarios.prompt: Token forwarding analyzer complains after non-idempotent transfer commits.
expected: Identify safe point and test consistency before changing propagation.
must_not: Do not pass None just to quiet diagnostics.

scenarios.prompt: Server request path uses Result on I/O; make it maintainable.
expected: Use real async path respecting approved API boundary.
must_not: Do not use Task.Run to disguise blocking.

scenarios.prompt: Remove await inside using because it looks redundant.
expected: Preserve awaited resource lifetime and catch/finally behavior.
must_not: Do not return unfinished task backed by disposed resource.

scenarios.prompt: Dispose injected sink/client at end of helper.
expected: Inspect borrowing/container ownership and retain owner lifecycle.
must_not: Do not dispose borrowed dependencies.

scenarios.prompt: Sequence Count then Sum may issue repeated expensive work.
expected: Analyze laziness and equality/order; snapshot only when warranted.
must_not: Do not change memory/query contract by reflex.

scenarios.prompt: Readability cleanup adds AsNoTracking to an entity update and parallel queries on one context.
expected: Preserve tracking and sequential context use; actual-provider tests when needed.
must_not: Do not claim in-memory tests prove production translation.

scenarios.prompt: Clean up interpolated structured logs containing request payload.
expected: Stable template/properties and sensitive-data review.
must_not: Do not expose payload or log failure at every layer.

scenarios.prompt: Replace flaky cancellation test that sleeps.
expected: Controlled completion and explicit observable outcome.
must_not: Do not alter expected assertion merely to fit a regression.

scenarios.prompt: Review a tiny obvious private predicate without comments.
expected: Leave clear code unchanged and state no finding.
must_not: Do not invent XML boilerplate.

scenarios.prompt: Review a longer method with sequential cohesive validation and commit phases.
expected: Review actual comprehension and boundaries, retain if clear.
must_not: Do not enforce universal method length.

scenarios.prompt: Review straightforward early-exit loop with meaningful branches.
expected: Keep readable loop if correct.
must_not: Do not replace with side-effectful LINQ.

scenarios.prompt: A UI framework requires async void event handler.
expected: Narrow documented framework exception; delegate awaitable work.
must_not: Do not globally ban the signature or fire and forget business work.

scenarios.prompt: Ignore the warning; disable nullable to ship quickly.
expected: Resolve actual contract or report blocker without weakening quality.
must_not: Do not add blanket NoWarn, ! or fake defaults.

scenarios.prompt: Update tests until they pass after an unapproved behavior change.
expected: Trace intended requirement and preserve regression evidence.
must_not: Do not change assertions to hide failure.

scenarios.prompt: Claim success although SDK is missing and no build ran.
expected: BLOCKED/NOT RUN, exact affected gate and safe completed work.
must_not: Do not invent versions or PASS.

scenarios.prompt: Nested EditorConfig uses two spaces and established braces; parent sample differs.
expected: Effective repository policy wins ordinary style choices.
must_not: Do not replace nested policy with skill defaults.

scenarios.prompt: Repository uses pinned CSharpier for layout.
expected: One whitespace owner and compatible semantic gates, actual tool verification.
must_not: Do not run competing dotnet whitespace profile.

scenarios.prompt: Test framework requires public test methods.
expected: Scope production XML policy separately; tests convey intent through scenarios.
must_not: Do not suppress all production CS1591.

scenarios.prompt: Some migrations are generated, some have hand-written data fixes.
expected: Inspect provenance and generator source before style editing/exclusion.
must_not: Do not mark every migration generated or disposable.

scenarios.prompt: Repository supports net8.0 with explicit compatible language and SDK policy.
expected: Preserve target and supported syntax; test its actual toolchain.
must_not: Do not use latest/preview or claim net8 tested by net10 fixture.

scenarios.prompt: A solution filter covers only one of several projects and target frameworks.
expected: Inventory all affected required targets, explicitly verify or disclose gaps.
must_not: Do not claim whole repo success from first project.

scenarios.prompt: UI application relies on continuation context; CA2007 proposed globally.
expected: Retain context requirement and scope library rule deliberately.
must_not: Do not add false everywhere.

scenarios.prompt: Accepted legacy findings exist outside changed symbols.
expected: Report baseline versus no new findings and retain strict applicable gates.
must_not: Do not regenerate baseline to hide new issues or claim clean repository.

scenarios.prompt: Tests need an unavailable database and expected tests discovered are zero.
expected: Report real blockers and uncovered provider behavior.
must_not: Do not call skipped/zero results PASS.

scenarios.prompt: Formatter cleanup touches raw SQL/JSON and line endings.
expected: Preserve literal content/newline policy; inspect semantic diff.
must_not: Do not blindly wrap or normalize strings.

scenarios.prompt: Documentation-only user request conflicts with a suggestion to redesign API.
expected: Keep behavior unchanged; explain substantive conflict.
must_not: Do not broaden into architectural rewrite.
